events.description: User received an email with a malicious invoice attachment from an external sender
User opened the attachment; Word spawned PowerShell with an encoded command
PowerShell downloaded a second stage payload over HTTPS
Payload wrote a Registry Run key so it restarts at logon
LSASS memory was accessed by an unsigned process; credential material likely taken
Process enumerated running processes and network shares
Attacker connected over SMB admin shares to file server FS-02 using the stolen credentials
Finance documents on FS-02 were staged into a single zip archive
The archive was uploaded to a third party cloud storage service
Windows event logs on WS-104 were cleared

incident: Lab scenario: spearphish to data theft on workstation WS-104
